content.text: I'm stopping here — too many colours and red minus signs. I'll ask my son before I do anything.

input.answer: According to the site, the cheapest place is פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ with the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה (4D) S&P 500", and you would have about 72,104 ₪ after ten years from 60,000 ₪ put in. But I don't know פסגות and I wouldn't move anything before I ask you or the bank.

stuck.why: 'סכום היום' started at 10,000 and I had to notice that and change it to 0 myself. Before that, the first big number I saw was 86,492.
It gave an amount but didn't name the bank or the fund. I had to scroll to find out who 'הזול' was.

stuck.where: Fees bar chart and the fund list with red minus amounts
stuck.why: There were many colours and red minus numbers ('−31 ₪', '−577 ₪'). It frightened me and I stopped there.
